summary: Implemented EE-03 (Task Activation): created src/tasks/store.zig (TaskStore with createInTx and list), extended src/engine/instance.zig with InstanceStore.applyTransition(), created src/api/routes/tasks.zig (GET /tasks handler), and registered both new modules in src/main.zig and src/bpm.zig. zig build exits 0; zig build test exits 0.

acceptance_criteria_verification.description: When a HUMAN_TASK node is entered, a Task record with status=PENDING is created
acceptance_criteria_verification.satisfied_by: InstanceStore.applyTransition() step f calls TaskStore.createInTx() for each node_id in new_task_node_ids; INSERT RETURNING persists with status='PENDING'

acceptance_criteria_verification.description: Task record contains: task_id, instance_id, node_id, assignee_type, assignee_ref, created_at
acceptance_criteria_verification.satisfied_by: Task struct in src/tasks/store.zig contains all required fields; INSERT RETURNING reads them back from DB

acceptance_criteria_verification.description: Task creation is atomic with the state transition event (DB-03)
acceptance_criteria_verification.satisfied_by: applyTransition steps c-g are a single DB transaction (BEGIN…COMMIT); event INSERT (step d), projection UPDATE (step e), and task INSERTs (step f) all commit together or ROLLBACK

acceptance_criteria_verification.description: START, END, gateway nodes do NOT create Task records
acceptance_criteria_verification.satisfied_by: pending_task_nodes is only populated by transition() for HUMAN_TASK nodes (EE-02 pure function, not modified); applyTransition only creates tasks for nodes in new_task_node_ids which derives from pending_task_nodes set-difference

acceptance_criteria_verification.description: Newly created Task is visible via GET /tasks immediately after commit
acceptance_criteria_verification.satisfied_by: GET /tasks route calls TaskStore.list() which queries the committed tasks table; tasks are committed in applyTransition step g before any subsequent request is processed

security_review.sql_injection: PASS — all SQL values bound as $N positional parameters in both createInTx and list(); no user-supplied value interpolated into SQL strings
security_review.transition_io_constraint: PASS — transition() is called in applyTransition step a BEFORE acquiring any DB connection; src/engine/transition.zig was not modified
security_review.nullif_assignee: PASS — createInTx uses NULLIF($5, '') and NULLIF($6, '') to handle null assignee_type/ref without SQL concatenation
security_review.limit_clamping: PASS — list() clamps limit to 1-200 range (0 → 50); handleList() also clamps before calling list()
